entry.summary: I have been using SSH for a very long time. SSH itself is not the problem. OpenSSH is mature, ubiquitous, scriptable, compatible with just about everything, and already knows how to deal with keys, agents, jump hosts, port forwards, certificates, host verification and all the other things accumulated over decades of people administering Unix machines.
